Name: Dynamic Sam Three Heart Event
Author: deleted127110843
Description:
This mod was inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8113]Sam's Three Heart Event in Any Year[/url], which is a lovely mod that adds the functionality to see the event past the first year. I expanded on this by changing the event so that if it [i]is [/i]triggered past the first year, it changes to reflect Kent's coming home.

If you just want to see the event without my edits, I recommend downloading the other mod!

Warning that this mod [i]does [/i]deal with aspects of war and PTSD, as well as some brief mentions of mental health stigma in my edited event.

Manifest.Name: Dynamic Sam Three Heart Event
Manifest.Description: This mod makes it so that Sam's three heart event can be seen no matter the year, but also changes the event to reflect Kent's coming home if it is triggered past Y1.
Manifest.Author: Pebble
